_comment: AORebirth generation policy, not a reconstruction of Funcom selection probabilities. QL2 team captures have two floors; QL220 has five. Intermediate sizes/floor bands are configurable policy. Team layout support reserves a separate boss floor; team acceptance and boss population are a subsequent milestone. Room roles and exact floor-travel anchors live in DungeonEntrances.json.

Population._comment: AORebirth ordinary-NPC policy: references to existing nonalien NpcTemplates families whose leaf name/MonsterData/NPCFamily match captured missions. Not a reconstruction of retail hashes, selection weights, or the full human/high-level population. NPC resolution requests mission QL and uses existing interpolation/clamping; this older catalog has gaps and upper limits (ANDR106, ROLL47, other families85). See docs/evidence/MISSION_DUNGEON_NPC_POPULATION_EVIDENCE.md. Bosses, objectives and loot are separate.
